column5: - `sem/storage.rs:1213`: activation flow ignores unlisted operation kinds (traced partly). `:1263, 1304, 1324, 1371`: a missing argument list reads as empty and `zip` truncates on a count mismatch, so claims bound to unmatched arguments are not relocated. `:3651, 3660` and `sem/structural.rs:5481, 5730, 5782`: a sum whose all-zero tag does not select its first case is accepted as zero-valid; `:5731` emits a signed 32-bit tag regardless of target. `sem/storage.rs:3638`: erased fields not filtered. `:2251-2265`: an opaque type with no representation row and no carrier link is treated as plain storage.
- `sem/structural.rs:2090-2099`: a constant index into an array whose length is an application is accepted for any index. `:90-92`: fields with no inline carrier are skipped, not flagged.
- `sem/substitution.rs:365-383`: content-term rebasing drops the path prefix.

- `sem/descriptor_replay.rs:830-832, 898-904`: `prepare_flow` skips steps with no snapshot and calls with unresolved contents (flow consumers not read). `:1850-1852`: an unresolvable case subject makes the branch feasible (reader: callers that need "established" require an exact fact, so no acceptance found).

- `sem/descriptors.rs:1648-1665`: a pure-predicate row listed in `additional_input` is treated as not constraining a store. `:1705-1706`: a shared reinterpreting reference drops all source membership obligations. `:5209-5244`: a scalar write with unresolved or several destinations does not retire the earlier observation. `:9634`: scalar writes by unlisted operation kinds are invisible to the capture. `:11663, 12426`: unlisted operation kinds record no payload invalidation or derivation. `:13488, 13589, 13593`: an empty graph on any internal failure (in-crate consumers fail closed; outside callers not traced). `:13694`: every other place kind is a plain local. `:653-655, 421-423`: an edge to a missing step contributes nothing.
- `TP/identity.rs:89-98`: parameter, callable and result text compared with `!=` on `Option<&str>`; two missing or two empty identities compare equal.
- `TP/boundary.rs:301, 339, 345, 419` and `TP/ownership.rs:1033`: a missing identity hashes as the empty string, so two such applications or plans collide.

- `TP/boundary.rs:1288-1290` and `TP/types_and_values.rs:1263-1265`: an unknown structural type id is skipped in the type walk. `TP/boundary.rs:1243-1251`: other external binding kinds pass unchecked.
